title: M0 Foundations
description: Repo, monorepo scaffold, CI/DevSecOps pipeline, design tokens, core document model, ADRs, threat model. Everything later builds on this.

title: M1 Ink Editor Alpha
description: Pen-first editor on iPad, Android tablet and Web: ink engine, brushes, pages, undo, local storage, palette dock. Lag-proof latency budget met.

title: M2 Library & Documents
description: Notebook library, subjects, templates, PDF import/annotation, images, typed text, basic search.

title: M3 Audio & Recognition
description: Audio recording synced to ink/text, on-device transcription, handwriting recognition & search, OCR, math.

title: M4 Identity, Sync & Privacy
description: Sign in with Google/Microsoft/Apple + phone OTP (bypass in dev), profiles, local-first sync through the user's iCloud Drive / Google Drive, end-to-end encryption, backup/restore.

title: M5 Phones & Platform Parity
description: iPhone and Android phone experiences, device/OS/architecture compatibility matrix, performance hardening on low-end hardware, foldables.

title: M6 Collaboration, Sharing & Sage AI
description: Sharing & export, real-time collaboration, comments, Sane Sage on-device AI (summaries, Q&A, flashcards), study tools.

title: M7 Beta Hardening & Security Audit
description: Penetration test, MASVS/ASVS verification, accessibility audit, perf soak, store-readiness, privacy labels.

title: M8 Launch & Growth
description: Billing & entitlements, student verification, marketing site, store launch, opt-in telemetry, support & docs.

title: Backlog
description: Ideas and lower-priority work not yet scheduled.
